documentType.description: Defines the document type to be opened

height.description: Defines the document height (100% by default) in the browser window

width.description: Defines the document width (100% by default) in the browser window

token.description: Defines the encrypted signature added to the ONLYOFFICE Docs config in the form of a token

type.description: Defines the platform type used to access the document. Default: desktop

document.description: Defines document parameters and access settings

fileType.description: Defines the type of the file for the source viewed or edited document. Must be lowercase.

isForm.description: Defines if the PDF file is a PDF form or a standard PDF file. Default: true

key.description: Defines the unique document identifier used by the service to recognize the document. Must be unique, max 128 characters. Allowed chars: 0-9, a-z, A-Z, -._=

referenceData.description: Defines an object that is generated by the integrator to uniquely identify a file in its system

fileKey.description: The unique document identifier used by the service to get a link to the file

title.description: Defines the desired file name for the viewed or edited document. Max 128 characters.

url.description: Defines the absolute URL where the source viewed or edited document is stored

permissions.description: Allows to change the permission for the document to be edited and downloaded or not

changeHistory.description: Allows to display the Restore button when using the onRequestRestore event. Default: false. Deprecated since 5.5.

chat.description: Defines if the chat functionality is enabled in the document. Default: true

comment.description: Defines if the document can be commented or not. Default coincides with edit parameter.

commentGroups.description: Defines the groups whose comments the user can edit, remove and/or view

oneOf.description: The user can edit comments made by other users
Empty string means user can edit comments from any group
The user can remove comments made by other users
The user can view comments made by other users
Empty string means user can view comments from any group

copy.description: Defines if the content can be copied to the clipboard. Default: true

deleteCommentAuthorOnly.description: Defines if the user can delete only his/her comments. Default: false

download.description: Defines if the document can be downloaded or only viewed/edited online. Default: true

edit.description: Defines if the document can be edited or only viewed. Default: true

editCommentAuthorOnly.description: Defines if the user can edit only his/her comments. Default: false

fillForms.description: Defines if the forms can be filled. Default coincides with edit or review parameter.

modifyContentControl.description: Defines if the content control settings can be changed. Default: true

modifyFilter.description: Defines if the filter can be applied globally (true) or locally (false). Default: true

print.description: Defines if the document can be printed. Default: true

protect.description: Defines if the Protection tab on the toolbar is displayed. Default: true

rename.description: Allows to display the Rename button. Default: false. Deprecated since 6.0.

review.description: Defines if the document can be reviewed. Default coincides with edit parameter.

reviewGroups.description: Defines the groups whose changes the user can accept/reject

userInfoGroups.description: Defines the groups of users whose information is displayed in the editors

info.description: Allows to change additional parameters for the document (owner, folder, uploading date, sharing settings)

author.description: Defines the name of the document author/creator. Deprecated since 5.4, use owner instead.

created.description: Defines the document creation date. Deprecated since 5.4, use uploaded instead.

favorite.description: Defines the highlighting state of the Favorite icon. If undefined/null, the icon is not displayed.

folder.description: Defines the folder where the document is stored (can be empty for root folder)

owner.description: Defines the name of the document owner/creator

isLink.description: Changes the user icon to the link icon

permissions.description: The access rights for the user

user.description: The name of the user the document will be shared with

sharingSettings.description: Displays the information about the settings which allow to share the document with other users

editorConfig.description: Allows to change the parameters pertaining to the editor interface: opening mode, language, buttons, etc.

actionLink.description: Specifies the data received from the document editing service using the onMakeActionLink event or the onRequestSendNotify event

callbackUrl.description: Specifies absolute URL to the document storage service (required)

coEditing.description: Defines the co-editing mode (Fast or Strict) and the possibility to change it

change.description: Defines if the co-editing mode can be changed in the editor interface. Default: true

createUrl.description: Defines the absolute URL of the document where it will be created and available after creation

lang.description: Defines the editor interface language using two-letter language codes (de, ru, it, etc.). For Portuguese (Portugal) or Chinese (Traditional, Taiwan) use pt-PT or zh-TW. Default: en

location.description: Defines the default measurement units. Specify us or ca for inches. Deprecated since 8.2, use region parameter instead.

mode.description: Defines the editor opening mode. Default: edit

folder.description: The folder where the document is stored

title.description: The document title that will be displayed in the Open Recent menu

url.description: The absolute URL to the document

recent.description: Defines the presence or absence of the documents in the Open Recent menu option

region.description: Defines the default display format for currency and date/time using four letter codes (en-US, fr-FR, etc.). Default: en-US

image.description: The absolute URL to the image for template

title.description: The template title that will be displayed in the Create New menu

url.description: The absolute URL to the document where it will be created

templates.description: Defines the presence or absence of the templates in the Create New menu option

user.description: Defines the user currently viewing or editing the document

firstname.description: The first name of the user. Deprecated since 4.2, use user.name instead

group.description: The group (or several groups separated with commas) the user belongs to

id.description: The identification of the user. Max 128 characters. Recommended to use anonymized hash.

image.description: The path to the user's avatar

lastname.description: The last name of the user. Deprecated since 4.2, use user.name instead

name.description: The full name of the user. Max 128 characters. Used since version 4.2.

customization.description: Allows to customize editor interface and behavior

about.description: Defines if the About menu button is displayed or hidden

request.description: Defines if to request anonymous user label

autosave.description: Defines if autosave is enabled or disabled

close.description: Defines settings for the Close button

comments.description: Defines if the comments functionality is enabled

compactHeader.description: Defines if the editor header is displayed in a compact mode

compactToolbar.description: Defines if the editor toolbar is displayed in a compact mode

compatibleFeatures.description: Defines if compatible features are enabled

featuresTips.description: Defines if tooltips about new editor features will be displayed. Default: true

roles.description: Defines if role settings are disabled in pdf forms. Default: true

mode.description: Defines if the spell checker is automatically switched on or off

spellcheck.description: Defines if the spell checker is enabled

mode.description: The tab background mode. Default: header

change.description: Defines if the tab background setting will be displayed

tabBackground.description: Defines the background of the top toolbar tabs

mode.description: The tab style mode. Default: fill

change.description: Defines if the tab style setting will be displayed

tabStyle.description: Defines the style of the top toolbar tabs

url.description: The absolute URL to the website address for feedback

visible.description: Shows or hides the Feedback & Support menu button

feedback.description: Defines settings for the Feedback & Support menu button. Default: false

forcesave.description: Adds the request for force saving when saving the document. Default: false

forceWesternFontSize.description: Defines if Western (true) or Chinese (false) font size is used in Chinese UI. Default: false

goback.description: Defines settings for the Open file location menu button

blank.description: Opens the website in a new browser tab (true) or current tab (false). Default: true

requestClose.description: Calls events.onRequestClose instead of opening a browser tab. Deprecated since 8.1.

text.description: The text for the Open file location button

url.description: The absolute URL to open when clicking the button

help.description: Defines if the Help menu button is displayed or hidden. Default: true

hideNotes.description: Defines if the note panel is displayed or hidden on first loading. Available for presentation editor only. Default: false

hideRightMenu.description: Defines if the right menu is displayed or hidden on first loading. Default: true

hideRulers.description: Defines if the editor rulers are displayed or hidden. Default: false for documents, true for presentations

integrationMode.description: Defines the mode of embedding editors into the web page

logo.description: Changes the image file at the top left corner of the editor header. Recommended height: 20 pixels.

imageDark.description: Path to the image file for dark header (300x20)

imageLight.description: Path to the image file for light header (300x20)

imageEmbedded.description: Path to the image file for embedded mode (248x40). Deprecated since 7.0.

url.description: The absolute URL which will be used when someone clicks the logo image

visible.description: Shows or hides the logo. Default: true

macros.description: Defines if document macros will be automatically run when the editor opens. Default: true

macrosMode.description: Defines the macros run mode when autostart is enabled. Default: warn

mentionShare.description: Defines the hint that describes the event after mentions in a comment. Default: true

mobile.description: Defines the mobile document editor settings

forceView.description: Defines whether the view mode is enabled on launch. Default: true

info.description: Defines whether the Document Info button is displayed. Default: false

standardView.description: Defines whether the editor will be opened in Standard view. Default: false

mobileForceView.description: Defines if the mobile document editor is opened in view/edit mode on launch. Deprecated since 8.2, use mobile parameter instead.

plugins.description: Defines if plugins will be launched and available. Default: true

pointerMode.description: Defines the pointer mode when the presentation editor is loaded in the viewer. Default: select

review.description: Contains the information about the review mode

hideReviewDisplay.description: Defines if the Display mode button is displayed on the Collaboration tab. Default: false

hoverMode.description: Defines the review display mode: tooltips (true) or balloons (false). Default: false

reviewDisplay.description: Defines the review display mode. Default: original

showReviewChanges.description: Defines if the review changes panel is automatically displayed. Default: false

trackChanges.description: Defines if the document is opened in the review editing mode. Default: depends on document.permissions.review

reviewDisplay.description: Defines the review editing mode in the document editor. Deprecated since 7.0, use review.reviewDisplay instead.

showHorizontalScroll.description: Defines if the horizontal scroll is automatically displayed when the spreadsheet editor is loaded. Available since 8.3. Default: true

showReviewChanges.description: Defines if the review changes panel is automatically displayed. Deprecated since 7.0, use review.showReviewChanges instead.

showVerticalScroll.description: Defines if the vertical scroll is automatically displayed when the spreadsheet editor is loaded. Available since 8.3. Default: true

slidePlayerBackground.description: Defines the background color for the slide show in the presentation editor. Can be HEX, RGB, or RGBA. Available since 8.3.

spellcheck.description: Defines if the spell checker is automatically switched on or off. Deprecated since 7.1, use features.spellcheck instead.

visible.description: Defines whether the Complete & Submit button will be displayed. Default: true

resultMessage.description: Defines a message displayed after forms are submitted

submitForm.description: Defines the Complete & Submit button settings. Available since 8.3. Default: true

suggestFeature.description: Defines whether the Suggest a Feature menu button will be displayed. Default: true

toolbarHideFileName.description: Defines if the document title is visible on the top toolbar. Default: false

toolbarNoTabs.description: Defines if the top toolbar tabs are distinctly displayed (false) or only highlighted (true). Deprecated since 8.2.

trackChanges.description: Defines if the document is opened in the review editing mode. Deprecated since 7.0, use review.trackChanges instead.

uiTheme.description: Defines the editor theme settings. Default: theme-classic-light

unit.description: Defines the measurement units used on the ruler. Default: cm

wordHeadingsColor.description: Defines the HEX color for the default heading styles in the document editor. Available since 8.3.

zoom.description: Defines the document display zoom value in percent. Can be -1 (fit to page) or -2 (fit width). Default: 100

editMode.description: Defines if the header is displayed in edit mode. Default: true

save.description: Defines if the Save button is displayed. Default: true

user.description: Defines if the user name and avatar are displayed. Default: true

users.description: Defines if the button with the editing users is displayed. Default: true

mode.description: Defines the initial value of the left panel visibility. Default: true

navigation.description: Defines if the Navigation button is displayed. Available for document editor only. Default: true

spellcheck.description: Defines if the Spellcheck button is displayed. Available for spreadsheet editor only. Default: true

mode.description: Defines the initial value of the right panel visibility. Default: true

actionStatus.description: Defines if an action status is displayed. Default: true

docLang.description: Defines if a button for choosing the document language is displayed. Available for document and presentation editors. Default: true

textLang.description: Defines if a button for choosing the text language is displayed. Available for document and presentation editors. Default: true

mailmerge.description: Defines if the button for choosing the mail merge base is displayed. Default: true

draw.description: Defines if the Draw tab is displayed. Default: true

close.description: Defines if the Close menu option is displayed. Default: true

info.description: Defines if the Document info option is displayed. Default: true

save.description: Defines if the Save option is displayed. Default: true

settings.description: Defines if the Advanced settings option is displayed. Default: true

home.description: Defines the Home tab settings. This tab cannot be hidden.

layout.description: Defines if the Layout tab is displayed. Available for document and spreadsheet editors. Default: true

plugins.description: Defines if the Plugins tab is displayed. Default: true

protect.description: Defines if the Protection tab is displayed. Default: true

references.description: Defines if the References tab is displayed. Available for document editor only. Default: true

save.description: Defines if the Save button on the toolbar is displayed. Used when compactHeader is true. Default: true

navigation.description: Defines if the Navigation button is displayed. Available for document editor only. Default: true

leftMenu.description: Defines if the left menu panel is displayed or hidden. Deprecated since 7.1, use layout.leftMenu instead.

loaderLogo.description: Defines the path to the image logo which will be displayed while the document is being loaded

loaderName.description: Defines the text which will be displayed while the document is being loaded
examples: The document is loading, please wait...

rightMenu.description: Defines if the right menu panel is displayed or hidden. Deprecated since 7.1, use layout.rightMenu instead.

statusBar.description: Defines if the status bar is displayed or hidden. Deprecated since 7.1, use layout.statusBar instead.

toolbar.description: Defines if the top toolbar is displayed or hidden. Deprecated since 7.1, use layout.toolbar instead.

embedded.description: Defines settings for the embedded viewer

embedUrl.description: Defines the absolute URL which will be used when clicking the embed button

fullscreenUrl.description: Defines the absolute URL which will be used when clicking the fullscreen button

saveUrl.description: Defines the absolute URL that will allow the document to be saved onto the user's computer

shareUrl.description: Defines the absolute URL that will allow other users to share this document

toolbarDocked.description: Defines the place for the embedded viewer toolbar

autostart.description: Defines the array of plugin GUIDs that will be automatically started

options.description: Defines an object which allows configuring plugins from an external source

all.description: Defines the parameters which will be set for all plugins

pluginsData.description: Defines the array of absolute URLs to the plugin configuration files (config.json)

url.description: Defines the absolute URL to the directory where the plugins are stored. Deprecated since 4.3.

events.description: Defines event handlers for document editor

onAppReady.description: The function called when the application is loaded into the browser

onCollaborativeChanges.description: The function called when the document is co-edited by another user in the strict co-editing mode

onDocumentReady.description: The function called when the document is loaded into the document editor

onDocumentStateChange.description: The function called when the document is modified

onDownloadAs.description: The function called with the absolute URL to the edited file when the downloadAs method is being called

onError.description: The function called when an error or some other specific event occurs

onInfo.description: The function called when the application opened the file

onMakeActionLink.description: The function called when the user is trying to get link for opening the document which contains a bookmark

onMetaChange.description: The function called when the meta information of the document is changed via the meta command

onOutdatedVersion.description: The function called after the error is shown, when the document is opened for editing with the old document.key value. Deprecated since 8.3, use onRequestRefreshFile instead.

onPluginsReady.description: The function called when all plugins are loaded and can be used

onReady.description: The function called when the application is loaded into the browser. Deprecated since 5.0, use onAppReady instead.

onRequestClose.description: The function called when the user is trying to end the work with the editor and close it

onRequestCompareFile.description: The function called when the user is trying to select document for comparing. Available only for ONLYOFFICE Docs Enterprise. Deprecated since 7.5, use onRequestSelectDocument instead.

onRequestCreateNew.description: The function called when the user is trying to create document by clicking the Create New button

onRequestEditRights.description: The function called when the user is trying to switch the document from viewing into editing mode

onRequestHistory.description: The function called when the user is trying to show the document version history

onRequestHistoryClose.description: The function called when the user is trying to go back to the document from viewing the document version history

onRequestHistoryData.description: The function called when the user is trying to click the specific document version in the document version history

onRequestInsertImage.description: The function called when the user is trying to insert an image by clicking the Image from Storage button

onRequestMailMergeRecipients.description: The function called when the user is trying to select recipients data by clicking the Mail merge button. Deprecated since 7.5, use onRequestSelectSpreadsheet instead.

onRequestOpen.description: The function called when the user is trying to open an external link by clicking the Open source button

onRequestReferenceData.description: The function called when the user is trying to refresh data inserted from the external file

onRequestReferenceSource.description: The function called when the user is trying to change a source of the external data by clicking the Change source button

onRequestRefreshFile.description: The function called instead of the onOutdatedVersion event when the editor is opened with key that was already used or when reconnecting after losing connection

onRequestRename.description: The function called when the user is trying to rename the file by clicking the Rename button

onRequestRestore.description: The function called when the user is trying to restore the file version by clicking the Restore button in the version history

onRequestSaveAs.description: The function called when the user is trying to save file by clicking Save Copy as button

onRequestSelectDocument.description: The function called when the user is trying to select a document for comparing, combining, or inserting text

onRequestSelectSpreadsheet.description: The function called when the user is trying to select recipients data by clicking the Mail merge button

onRequestSendNotify.description: The function called when the user is mentioned in a comment

onRequestSharingSettings.description: The function called when the user is trying to manage document access rights

onRequestStartFilling.description: The function called when the user is trying to start filling out the ready forms in pdf editing mode

onRequestUsers.description: The function called when the user can select other users to mention in the comments or grant the access rights

onSubmit.description: The function called when the force saving request is successfully performed, when the Complete & Submit button is clicked

onUserActionRequired.description: The function called when a user action is required to open a document (password, encoding selection, etc.)

onWarning.description: The function called when a warning occurs
